rules.title: Prohibition of Anti-Competitive Automated Rent Price-Fixing
rules.effectiveDateQuote: This Ordinance will take effect and be in force on the thirtieth day from and after its final passage.
rules.requirement: Landlords may not use algorithmic devices to set rental rates or occupancy levels. No person may sell, license, or provide algorithmic devices to landlords. An algorithmic device is software that uses nonpublic competitor data to advise or recommend rental rates or occupancy levels.
rules.quotedSpan: It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic device to a landlord... It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property.
rules.coverageDescription: All residential rental properties in San Diego.
exemptions: Software that publishes reports on rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical data more than 90 days old or from publicly available information, without recommending future rates or occupancy levels.
Software used to establish rental rates or income limits under local, state, or federal affordable housing program guidelines.
